name: hot_reload
description: Performs a hot reload of the active Flutter application. This will apply the latest code changes to the running application, while maintaining application state.  Reload will not update const definitions of global values. Requires "connect_dart_tooling_daemon" to be successfully called first.

clearRuntimeErrors.description: This is useful to clear out old errors that may no longer be relevant.
clearRuntimeErrors.title: Whether to clear runtime errors before hot reloading.
